motion.name: page-switch
motion.purpose: Non-demo page switch; only when Windows ClientAreaAnimation is enabled.

display.purpose: DIP; Viewbox may shrink to fit.

narrative.overview: 沿用 Windows 桌面操作习惯，以清晰的数据行、可区分的双时长和轻量导航呈现应用使用。0.3 增加应用每日额度、近 7/30 天本地分析和用户手动发起的可选 AI 回顾。用户可以独立选择明暗模式、材质和强调色；默认首次跟随系统并使用液态玻璃，之后恢复已保存的选择。界面使用简体中文。
keyCharacteristics: Theme tokens computed from user color and mode
Internal translucent material without desktop sampling
Five native WPF destinations with scrolling access
Application limits remind without closing or blocking applications
Local 7/30-day analysis with optional manually approved aggregate sharing
Shared cached local application icons alongside names, including time slices
Separate option-led AI configuration dialog; internal fixed prompt
Recorded-day calendar markers independent of selected-day state

rules.name: Selected label contrast
rules.body: Choice selected labels use Ink on AccentSoft; Accent remains the border. Verify the actual control combination, not just Accent on Surface.

rules.name: Material scope
rules.body: Glass gradients and opacity are computed in ThemeManager.Apply; soft/minimal surfaces are opaque. No custom shadow tokens exist.

dos: Use DynamicResource for runtime theme colors
Retain native Windows focus and scrolling
Preserve the original user accent in stored preferences
Keep both duration metrics explicit in charts, limits and summaries
Require preview, consent and a send action for optional AI requests; support cancellation
Document native WPF components and DIP dimensions without invented HTML/CSS snippets
donts: Do not treat idle as proof of not working
Do not record titles, URLs, document names, keystrokes or screenshots
Do not describe the material as desktop backdrop sampling
Do not close or block target applications or apply AI suggestions as limit rules
Do not include keys, paths or raw time segments in AI preview data or exports
